Read at `origin/main` `37617109` (git only). The card was measured on 18.1.0; the `ui/` half has since landed, and what is left produces outside `ui/`.

| item | on `origin/main` |
|:--|:--|
| Audit Log strings (title, subtitle, Open as list, Presets, filters, columns, System) | localized: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx` reads `console.system.auditLog.*` (e.g. the title at :446), keys in all packs (zh at `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` ~2542-2578). Only the `IP` column header stays a literal. |
| Datasources page title | localized: `DatasourceResourcePage.tsx:627` reads `engine.datasource.title`. |
| System Overview KPI subtitles Users / Sessions / Events | **still English**, produced by `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts` (:20 `label:'Users'`, :35, :63). `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.ts` has a `dashboards.system_overview` block but no `datasets` block (0 hits for `datasets:`; control `dashboards:` 1 hit in `en.ts`). The spec already defines `datasets.NAME.measures.M.label` in the translation bundle, so no spec change. |
| Feature Flags 「功能开关Beta」 | likely fixed: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsView.tsx` ~566-574 wraps title and Beta badge in `inline-flex … gap-2`. The text node still concatenates, so the accessible name reads without a space. |

**What is asked of triage:** the remaining work lands in `packages/platform-objects` (a `domain:server` package by the lane table), not in `ui/`. Re-route or split the card; the ui seat neither re-routes nor grades. Whether the runtime applies a `datasets` translation block to dashboard tiles was not measured.

## Triage: re-routed `domain:ui` → `domain:server` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-26T07:02Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. `pm:retriage` removed.

- The `domain:ui` seat's premise reading (6409757706, `origin/main` `37617109`) shows the `ui/` half has landed. The remaining English is the System Overview KPI subtitles, produced by `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts`, and the zh-CN bundle has no `datasets` block. That is `domain:server` by the lane table. The spec already defines `datasets.NAME.measures.M.label`, so there is no protocol change.
- **The dev first measures** whether the runtime applies a `datasets` translation block to dashboard tiles. If it does not, that is the actual fix, beside the zh-CN entries. The Feature Flags accessible-name space can ride along as a one-line `ui/` fix. Grade unchanged (p2 · `area:i18n`).
